item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Caramell Music Videos HQ
item.description:
Hi! I’m looking for the music videos by the Swedish group Caramell in better quality, since the ones I’ve found are in very low quality.

It’s worth mentioning that the group never included their music videos on their singles or albums. Their music videos were only sent to certain Swedish television channels, such as ZTV Sverige, which makes finding original or high-quality copies of them quite difficult nowadays.

I’ve been searching in different places, but so far I haven’t been able to find versions with really good quality. So I wanted to ask if anyone happens to have recordings of these music videos, whether from a TV broadcast, a promotional tape, or another source from that time.

Any help would be greatly appreciated. If you have any of the music videos in higher quality than the versions currently available online, I would really appreciate it if you could share them or let me know where I might be able to find them.
